messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick note on Northbridge onboardingwe're seeing p95 climb during peak hours and token spend drifting above their committed plan. I want to propose a low-risk pilot: post-train int8, add a compact model for tail requests, and a weighted routing canary to measure impact.

Mei (Northbridge): Thanks for the heads-up. Our biggest concern is preserving exactness for structured outputs (JSON tables). Any change that affects slot alignment is risky.

Raj (Optimize Eng): We can run a post-train int8 (opt-q) and build a compact variant (nb-compact-v1). We'll validate with their structured-output regression suite and a hallucination detector. Typical gains: ~1.5x throughput, p95 down 20-30% in bench runs.

Diego (Infra): I can provision a canary pool. Suggest 4% traffic for 48h to get stable tail metrics without wide exposure. Need eval set and explicit rollback thresholds.

Priya (CSM): Proposed rollback triggers:
- intent/slot F1 drop > 1.5% absolute
- slot-exact-match drop > 1% absolute
- hallucination rate > 1.4x baseline
- error rate increase > 0.5%
If any trigger fires, auto-rollback. All request/response diffs stored to customer's KMS S3 for audit.

Raj (Optimize Eng): I'll include an adversarial subset that stresses slot boundaries. Also will run token-cost simulations to estimate $/1k token impact.

Diego (Infra): Example routing snippet for Console (will mirror in infra):
```json
{
  "policy_name": "northbridge-compact-canary",
  "variant": "nb-compact-v1",
  "weight": 0.04,
  "duration": "48h",
  "monitors": {
    "intent_f1_min": 0.985,
    "slot_exact_min": 0.99,
    "max_error_rate": 0.005
  },
  "rollback_on": ["quality_drop","error_spike","sev_incident"]
}
```

OpsBot: Ticket CS-6009 created and assigned to @Diego and @Raj. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6009

Mei (Northbridge): I'll prepare a redacted eval bundle (1.5k sessions) and the JSON schema expectations. Will share via secure upload by EOD.

Hana (Renewals): Noted on renewal board. If pilot shows <=1% slot-exact delta and clear p95 wins, we can use as an upsell/renewal talking point. Please cc me on the results summary.

Priya (CSM): Next steps: 1) Mei uploads redacted eval set; 2) Raj builds int8 + compact variant and runs canary at 4% for 48h; 3) capture p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, intent/slot F1, slot-exact % and hallucination metric; 4) review + decision after canary. I'll draft a one-page customer note describing the pilot and rollback guarantees.

Raj (Optimize Eng): Scheduling canary for 08:30 PT tomorrow. Will post live Console link and interim metrics here.

Priya (CSM): Thanks team  I'll attach the runbook to CS-6009 when it's ready.
